item.description:
Audrey Hepburn (1929-1993) was an iconic British and Belgian actress, a symbol of elegance in Hollywood's golden age, and the muse of Givenchy. She won the Oscar for Best Actress for her debut in Roman Holiday (1953) and starred in such classics as Breakfast at Tiffany's . She dedicated her later years to humanitarian work as a UNICEF ambassador
